battle_shout.notes: L1 war cry now sets the weapon alight, blood-red shimmer and light trails ride the blade for the buff's whole 2-min life; rune orbit retired so runes stay rare.

thunder_clap.notes: First AoE unveil (L6): storm-charge spirals inward around the body for a beat before the weapon hits dirt and the 8yd shock ring answers, the gather makes the clap feel earned.

bloodrage.notes: Blood-for-rage made literal: crimson heartbeat rings thump off the chest for the duration, pure racing pulse, no rune flash, unmistakable from any other warrior buff.

defensive_stance.notes: The stance earns the 'stance' windup, feet plant, dust and pebbles lift, then steel shield facets orbit the body for the whole toggle so the tank silhouette reads at a glance.

execute.notes: THE warrior moment gets anticipation: half a second of grounded gather (dust rises, weapon hand glows deep red) before the colossal sky-strike overhead, the pause is what makes the clip.

slam.notes: Its 1.5s cast is now enchant-light crawling up the raised haft with climbing sparks, reads as charged melee being wound up, never a caster's rune circle.

cleave.notes: L18 finale differentiated from thunder_clap: a huge horizontal weapon-arc ribbon layered over the forward ring so it reads as one sweeping blade stroke, not another shock ring.

fireball.notes: De-runed: the molten orb swelling between the hands IS the first-spell fantasy - no circle needed.

frostbolt.notes: Cold gathers: freezing mist spirals inward and condenses into the coiled lance - reads COLD, not a blue fireball.

conjure_water.notes: A wobbling blue water orb condenses between the palms over the 3s cast; rune circle dropped, stays modest per the utility rule.

frost_armor.notes: Persistent frost-palette spark motes read as drifting ice-glint crystals - 'encased in frost' finally visible while it lasts.

arcane_intellect.notes: Glinting sigils orbit the head for the duration - the intellect fantasy made literal; sparks freed for Frost Armor.

polymorph.notes: THE mage ritual keeps the kit's only rune circle: arcane ceremony into poof into the pinned ghost-sheep rising - the L8 clip moment.

arcane_explosion.notes: Inhale/exhale: 0.25s violet vortex sucks power into the chest, then the ring detonates outward - spammable pulse rhythm, pure AoE-gather fantasy.

scorch.notes: Snap-cast filler: no windup telegraphy, the flame just ignites on the target - instant-feeling foil to fireball's swelling orb.

ice_barrier.notes: Interlocking ice facets orbit the body for the whole absorb - the L20 reward you can see; runes orbit retired to keep circles rare.

eviscerate.notes: Capstone keeps the twin blood cross-slash but gains a 0.2s grounded crouch (dust kick, late dagger-glow) so the finisher visibly coils before it erupts.

backstab.notes: L4 unveil: the same thrust now strikes from the blind spot in dark violet with a shadow-wisp trail, positional dagger work, no longer a recolored sinister_strike.

gouge.notes: Eye-rake is now three parallel raking gashes across the face (claws, never a sword arc) with the daze stars orbiting after, creature-true rule.

evasion.notes: Untouchable blur: smoke-grey afterimage fans flicker behind the shoulders like ghost-images of dodges, unique orbit, reads defensive without armor plates.

slice_and_dice.notes: Rune circle deleted (runes stay rare); the haste lives on the blades, both daggers shimmer and trail light-whirr for the duration.

sprint.notes: Wind-blur streaks stream off the legs for the whole buff, the L10 'I am fast now' moment finally looks like it.

kidney_shot.notes: Stun finisher goes visceral deep-red: brutal low jab with screen-weight impact and stun stars, blood palette splits it from gouge's steel claw-rake.

ambush.notes: THE L16 reward: shadows coil inward (the held breath), then the dagger plunges as a spectral shadow-fox pounces out of the dark onto the target, the clip moment.

adrenaline_rush.notes: Blood runs hot made literal: pulsing crimson rings thump off the chest like a racing pulse, the L20 capstone buff no longer shares sparks with evasion.

seal_of_righteousness.notes: It's an imbue, not a rune ritual: gilded enchantment crawls up the mace with climbing sparks, and the weapon keeps a golden glow + light trail while the seal lasts.

holy_light.notes: The big prayer answered from above: dawn-light gathers from the sky down onto the caster across the full 2.5s cast, then releases into the target.

devotion_aura.notes: Quiet 30-min litany: faint glinting devotional sigils orbit the armor, subtle enough to live with, and no longer identical to every other paladin buff.

judgement.notes: The kit's ONE rune-circle ritual: a golden verdict circle snaps underfoot for half a beat, the seal is consumed, and the skybeam gavel falls.

blessing_of_might.notes: A true benediction: spectral golden wing-fans unfurl and flap behind the ally's shoulders for the buff, a blessing visible across the battlefield, not another spark shell.

divine_protection.notes: Armor-of-light: translucent shield facets snap into orbit around the bubble for its duration, instant and off-GCD, so no windup; the plates ARE the absorb.

hammer_of_justice.notes: Justice does not telegraph: explicitly instant (no default rune circle), spectral golden maul flash + stun stars stay the kit's only CC read.

lay_on_hands.notes: The 10-minute miracle: the paladin's own light spirals inward off their body before pouring into the ally, the self-sacrifice made visible, unlike either cast heal.

flash_of_light.notes: The humble handcast: a compact warm light-orb cupped between the hands over the 1.5s cast, deliberately small next to Holy Light's sky-prayer.

exorcism.notes: Banishment made literal: on impact a ghostly spirit is TORN out of the target, rising and dissolving in the white-gold flare, the kit's one spirit moment, earned at L14.

consecration.notes: Hallowed ground: holy power spirals inward for half a beat, then slams outward to the full 8yd ring; extended linger keeps the gilded floor burning.

righteous_fury.notes: The tank switch: grounded stance windup (dust, pebbles, late hand-glow), then flame-gold heartbeat rings thumping off the chest, burning zeal you can practically hear.

raptor_strike.notes: Pinned raptor pounce kept; added grounded stance windup (dust, planted feet) so the on-next-swing wait reads as coiled anticipation before the spirit hits.

aspect_of_the_hawk.notes: The L4 unveil: a spectral hawk dives out of the sky onto the hunter and spectral wing fans keep beating behind the shoulders, no rune circle, the bird IS the cast.

serpent_sting.notes: Instant loose stays lean, fang-snap flash and rising venom fumes are already the kit's only dot; explicit none kills any inherited circle.

arcane_shot.notes: Instant violet quarrel, the kit's one arcane accent stays a zero-telegraph snapshot.

concussive_shot.notes: Blunt daze tracer fires from the hip; the wobble-shimmer linger differentiates it from aimed_shot, not a circle.

mongoose_bite.notes: Bite is not a sword swing: spectral jaws snap shut on the target the instant the dodge procs, pure reflex, zero windup, sibling contrast to raptor's deliberate stance.

wing_clip.notes: Quick low hamstring hack stays instant and humble, utility, not spectacle.

tame_beast.notes: The hunter's one true ritual earns the kit's only rune circle: the 6s bonding ceremony ends with the beast's wild spirit rising out of it as the drowsy stars settle, the pet-class covenant moment.

dismiss_pet.notes: Quiet release-to-the-wild veil stays understated; explicit none so no circle flashes on a farewell.

revive_pet.notes: Life gathers from the sky down onto the hunter during the cast, then pours into the leafy portal, resurrection light, unique windup in the kit.

aspect_of_the_cheetah.notes: A spectral fox sprints a full lap around the hunter and wind-blur streaks stay on the legs, speed you can see, no shared shell language with the hawk aspect.

aimed_shot.notes: The sniper payoff: enchantment and climbing sparks crawl up the bow for the full draw, tension peaks, then the killshot streaks flat, charge language owned by no other shot.

rapid_fire.notes: Plant the feet (dust kick), then pulsing rings thump off the chest like a racing pulse for the haste window, adrenaline, not another spark shell.

smite.notes: Level-1 hook: the 2s prayer pulls light DOWN from the sky onto the caster, then the skybeam burst answers on the target, call and response, no rune circle.

lesser_heal.notes: The novice prayer: a small warm orb cupped between the hands, deliberately humble so the later heals visibly outgrow it.

power_word_fortitude.notes: Fortitude finally LOOKS like fortitude, golden pulse rings thumping off the ally's chest for the duration; instant word, no windup.

power_word_shield.notes: The iconic bubble becomes armor of light: glassy shield facets orbiting the body (the engine's absorb language), replacing the generic rune orbit.

mind_blast.notes: The apocalyptic moment earns the kit's ONE spirit: dark power spirals inward during the 1.5s cast, and on detonation a ghost is torn upright out of the victim, their psyche made visible. Clip bait.

heal.notes: The class's single rune ritual: the full 2.5s prayer kneels over a scripture circle, the ceremony upgrade from lesser_heal that makes learning Heal feel like ordination.

mind_flay.notes: Catalog mechanic is drainTick, so the visual now honors it: the writhing violet mind-worm pulses TOWARD the caster, pulling something out of the victim's head, instantly distinct from arcane_missiles and from warlock's blood-red drain_life.

flash_heal.notes: The emergency heal is the only priest cast with NO ceremony, hands simply flare and light slams in; urgency reads through the absence every sibling heal has.

rockbiter_weapon.notes: Pinned weaponGlow kept; 0.5s hold lets the earthen enchant visibly crawl up the weapon with climbing grit-sparks before the glow settles.

healing_wave.notes: Ancestral spirits answer: soft water-green light gathers from the sky down onto the caster during the cast, no more default rune circle on the bread-and-butter heal.

earth_shock.notes: Grounded anticipation, dust and pebbles lift around the caster for a beat before the fault-line ground burst, making earth feel like EARTH versus frost_shock's instant snap.

lightning_shield.notes: A crackling storm-orb forms between the hands then splits apart into the orbiting spark orbs, the level-8 unveil is watching the shield assemble; 'sparks' orbit stays, it IS the ability.

flame_shock.notes: Instant searing brand, explicit none so the fire shock never inherits a rune circle; the rising-ember dot carries its identity.

frost_shock.notes: Instant flash-freeze snap, no windup, pure link-crack impact; the fast twin to earth_shock's grounded slam.

ghost_wolf.notes: Pinned wolf-circle spirit kept; the 2s cast becomes a true vortex (silver motes spiral inward to the implosion), and the form now streams wind-blur speedlines while it lasts, the travel-form clip moment.

stormstrike.notes: The level-40 payoff: electric-blue charge crawls up BOTH weapons with climbing sparks in a short pre-strike hold, then the twin uppercut ground-slam answers the locked lightning_bolt hue.

shadow_bolt.notes: Rune circle retired: the 1.7s cast now charges a coiling two-handed void orb, violet wisps sucked into its rim before launch.

immolate.notes: Heat spirals INWARD over the 2s cast (embers + shimmer converging on the chest), then the whole gathered charge dumps onto the target in the ignition whoomph.

corruption.notes: A festering black-green ichor orb swells between the palms, fly-swarm rot texture, nothing like shadow_bolt's clean void sphere, then seeps into the target.

searing_pain.notes: A white-hot pinpoint compressed between two fingertips, tiny and searing, the opposite silhouette of shadow_bolt's two-handed sphere, before the lean dart snaps out.

demon_skin.notes: Armor now reads as armor: dark leathery chitin plates orbiting the body instead of generic rune glints.

life_tap.notes: You pay in heartbeats, crimson pulse rings thump off the chest as health becomes mana; the kit's only heartbeat orbit, unmistakable at a glance.

summon_imp.notes: Earns the rare rune circle (a true 5s summoning rite): ember runes etch the portal, then a small ghostly demon claws up out of it as your first demon arrives, level-1 hook moment.

summon_voidwalker.notes: THE ritual: the heavyweight rune circle spins up the void portal and a hulking spectral voidwalker rises out of it, the demon actually appears.

fear.notes: Terror gathers as shadows spiral into the warlock, then a wailing ghost rises through the victim as the tendrils claw over them, the clip-worthy unveil.

wrath.notes: Rune circle gone: a crackling verdant orb charges between the hands and the bolt coils with spiraling leaf motes, so it reads druid, not mage.

healing_touch.notes: Sunlight filters down through an unseen canopy onto the caster across the 2.5s cast, then releases into the full flower-ring bloom.

mark_of_the_wild.notes: The level-1 clip: a ghostly stag runs one proud lap around the blessed ally while the leaf motes spiral up, the Wild itself acknowledging them.

entangling_roots.notes: Grounded stance windup: dust and pebbles shiver as the earth cracks underfoot, selling the vines about to erupt.

bear_charge.notes: A spectral bear lunges along the gallop, overlaying the charging druid; L10's answer to the warrior's bull.

maul.notes: Paw, not blade: three raking gashes crash down together with the ground slam.

rake.notes: Claws arc in blood palette, bleeding rakes torn across the target, clearly distinct from Claw's clean physical swipe.

claw.notes: True claw arc: three parallel gashes replace the sword uppercut on the bread-and-butter builder.

ferocious_bite.notes: Bite must not be a sword swing: spectral jaws snap shut on the target with a bleeding deep-red crunch.

swipe.notes: Claw-rake gashes layered over the low nova ring so the bear AoE reads paw-swipe, not shockwave.

regrowth.notes: Life-motes vortex inward around the druid then release as the fast bloom, the inverse of Healing Touch's descending light.

thorns.notes: No windup flash; the orbiting spark orbs re-tint as glinting thorn barbs circling the bramble shell (unique orbit kept).

barkskin.notes: Bark-textured facets orbit as shield plates (rune orbit retired to keep circles rare); instant panic button, no windup.

starfire.notes: The one sanctioned ritual: a constellation rune circle under a long ceremonial 2.5s charge for the druid class signature.
